generated.as:
100.0
    * (least(greatest(coalesce(
        cvss_score,
        CASE lower(coalesce(severity_level, ''))
            WHEN 'critical' THEN 9
            WHEN 'high'     THEN 7.5
            WHEN 'medium'   THEN 5
            WHEN 'low'      THEN 2
            ELSE 4
        END
      ), 0), 10) / 10.0)
    * (CASE
        WHEN kev_listed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0
        WHEN epss_score IS NULL THEN 0.1
        ELSE power(least(greatest(epss_score, 0), 1), 1/3.0)
      END)
